fig:field_summary.caption: High-level overview of retrieved literature and subfield counts.
fig:field_summary.label: fig:field_summary

metadata.alt_text: Horizontal bars run from zero to each configured subfield's paper count; labels at the bar ends give both the count and its percentage of the current corpus, while the title reports the corpus total.

fig:subfield_distribution.caption: Distribution of subfields, with categories below 2% grouped as 'Other'.
fig:subfield_distribution.label: fig:subfield_distribution

metadata.alt_text: Donut chart partitions the current corpus by configured subfield. Each slice is labelled with its percentage, the centre reports total N, and subfields below two percent are pooled into an Other slice.

fig:growth_curve.caption: Annual and cumulative growth of publications over time.
fig:growth_curve.label: fig:growth_curve

metadata.alt_text: Dual-axis time series with annual publication counts as bars, a dashed moving-average line, and cumulative publications as a marked line. Annotations identify the peak year, median year, total N, span, and CAGR.

fig:subfield_timeline.caption: Temporal evolution of publications by subfield.
fig:subfield_timeline.label: fig:subfield_timeline

metadata.alt_text: Stacked area chart of publication counts by year. Coloured bands identify configured subfields, and their combined height at each year gives the annual corpus total; an inset reports total N across all bands.

fig:citation_network.caption: Citation network of the corpus, displaying up to 100 highest in-degree nodes.
fig:citation_network.label: fig:citation_network

metadata.alt_text: Directed spring-layout citation graph in which arrows represent citation links, node area increases with in-degree, and node colour denotes detected community when available. The five highest-in-degree papers are labelled.

fig:degree_distribution.caption: Degree distribution of nodes within the citation network.
fig:degree_distribution.label: fig:degree_distribution

metadata.alt_text: Histogram of paper in-degree in the directed citation graph, with the horizontal axis giving citations received and the vertical axis giving the number of papers; logarithmic axes are used when the degree range is large.

fig:hypothesis_dashboard.caption: Dashboard showing evidence scores for proposed hypotheses.
fig:hypothesis_dashboard.label: fig:hypothesis_dashboard

metadata.alt_text: Horizontal evidence-score bars for the configured hypotheses on a scale from minus one to plus one. Orange bars extend left for contradictory evidence, green bars extend right for supportive evidence, and zero is marked.

fig:word_cloud.caption: Word cloud of top weighted terms from the discovered topics.
fig:word_cloud.label: fig:word_cloud

metadata.alt_text: Term cloud derived from topic-term weights: more heavily weighted corpus terms appear in larger type, with a fixed layout seed and a cividis colour scale; word position and colour do not encode additional quantities.

fig:topic_term_bars.caption: Top terms and corresponding weights per discovered topic.
fig:topic_term_bars.label: fig:topic_term_bars

metadata.alt_text: Grid of horizontal bar charts, one panel per NMF topic. Each panel lists up to ten leading terms on the vertical axis, and bar length represents that term's weight in the topic.

fig:pca_embeddings.caption: PCA plot of TF-IDF vectors highlighting document clusters.
fig:pca_embeddings.label: fig:pca_embeddings

metadata.alt_text: Scatter plot projecting document TF-IDF vectors onto the first two principal components. Points are coloured by configured subfield, axes state explained variance, and arrows label the strongest well-separated term loadings.

fig:term_heatmap.caption: Heatmap of mean TF-IDF weights for terms selected by between-subfield variance.
fig:term_heatmap.label: fig:term_heatmap

metadata.alt_text: Heatmap with configured subfields as rows and the twenty terms with greatest between-subfield variance as columns. Cell colour from pale yellow to dark red encodes the subfield's mean TF-IDF weight for each term.

fig:dendrogram.caption: Hierarchical clustering dendrogram of subfield TF-IDF centroids.
fig:dendrogram.label: fig:dendrogram

metadata.alt_text: Ward-linkage dendrogram clustering configured subfields by their mean TF-IDF vectors. Leaves name subfields, branch height gives Ward distance, and an inset reports the cophenetic correlation of the hierarchy.

fig:cooccurrence_matrix.caption: Normalized co-occurrence matrix for the most frequent terms.
fig:cooccurrence_matrix.label: fig:cooccurrence_matrix

metadata.alt_text: Symmetric square matrix for the thirty most frequent document-level terms. Rows and columns list the same terms; increasingly dark blue cells indicate larger normalized within-document co-occurrence, with a zero diagonal.

fig:citation_distribution.caption: Histogram of citation counts with Gini coefficient of concentration.
fig:citation_distribution.label: fig:citation_distribution

metadata.alt_text: Vertical bars show how many retained papers fall in each citation-count bucket; bar-top labels give bucket counts, and the title reports the corpus size, total citations, and Gini concentration coefficient.

fig:top_venues.caption: Top publication venues by number of papers in the corpus.
fig:top_venues.label: fig:top_venues

metadata.alt_text: Descending horizontal bars rank up to fifteen publication venues by the number of retained corpus papers. Venue names appear on the vertical axis and bar length measures the paper count represented in the current evidence snapshot.

fig:author_productivity.caption: Top authors ranked by number of corpus publications.
fig:author_productivity.label: fig:author_productivity

metadata.alt_text: Descending horizontal bars rank up to twenty authors by their number of retained corpus publications. Author names appear on the vertical axis and bar length encodes publication count after the pipeline's record deduplication.

fig:entity_bar_chart.caption: Top named entities extracted from abstracts.
fig:entity_bar_chart.label: fig:entity_bar_chart

metadata.alt_text: Descending horizontal bars rank up to twenty named entities extracted from abstracts. Entity labels appear on the vertical axis and bar length represents the number of extracted occurrences in the current corpus.

fig:similarity_heatmap.caption: Top document pairs ranked by cosine similarity of TF-IDF/SVD embeddings.
fig:similarity_heatmap.label: fig:similarity_heatmap

metadata.alt_text: Ranked horizontal bars, despite the legacy heatmap filename, compare up to fifteen document pairs. Each label identifies a pair of paper IDs and bar length gives cosine similarity on a fixed zero-to-one axis.
